name: Anisotropic Voxelization
definition: Anisotropic voxelization improves result quality by storing directional data in voxels instead of isotropic (averaged) data, specifically addressing issues where surface normals cancel out in thin models (e.g., cloth) or cause light leaks.
summary: Anisotropic Voxelization stores directional data in six separate voxel grids to preserve face-specific values, preventing normal cancellation and light leaking in thin models.
